info.name: MarcatursHub
info.description: MarcatursHub API workspace. Implemented through Commission liability (MH-BE-019). Remaining folders are placeholders.

request.description: Unauthenticated liveness/readiness check. Does not require a bearer token.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public registration is limited to BUSINESS and AMBASSADOR. There is no public Register Admin request.

request.description: Authenticated self-service password change for the current user. Requires current_password. Keeps the current Sanctum token; revokes other tokens.

item.name: Businesses
item.description: Authenticated BUSINESS users manage only their own profile. There is no public or ID-based participant profile API in this task.

item.name: Verification — Participant
item.description: BUSINESS or AMBASSADOR. Complete a profile first. Placeholders only — do not attach real identity documents.

item.name: Verification — Administration
item.description: ADMIN only. Use a token from marcaturs:create-admin. Do not store real evidence in examples.

  "sort_order": 1
}

item.name: Categories
item.description: Public read of active, non-prohibited marketplace categories. Not a hard-coded sector list.

item.name: Categories — Administration
item.description: ADMIN only. Create and update category definitions, including listing_status and is_active.

item.name: Campaign Marketplace
item.description: Public discovery. Active and expiring campaigns with a published version. No Sanctum required.

item.name: Campaigns — Business
item.description: BUSINESS campaign shell and versioned commercial terms. Complete a profile first. Not discovery, deals, or payments.

item.name: Admin Users
item.description: MH-BE-039. BUSINESS/AMBASSADOR only. Discrete status actions require reason. ADMIN targets are not exposed.

item.name: Campaign Lifecycle — Administration
item.description: ADMIN moderation. Approve does not activate. Publish version first.

request.description: Admin campaign detail. When current_version is published, response includes commercial terms (product/pricing/commission/policies). Omits payment_account_identifier, payment_instructions, and payment_contact (marketplace redaction).

item.name: Campaign Extensions — Business
item.description: BUSINESS paid listing extension. Paystack platform purchase only. Publish ≠ activate ≠ extend.

item.name: Campaign Featured — Business
item.description: BUSINESS paid Premium Visibility. Independent of Extension. No refund for unused Featured time.

item.name: Campaign Extension Packages — Administration
item.description: ADMIN configurable duration and price. Example packages only; not product constants.

item.name: Campaign Featured Packages — Administration
item.description: ADMIN Featured packages. Separate from Extension packages. No paid-bypass activate.

item.name: Paystack Webhook
item.description: Provider callback. Signature required. Do not send secrets in the body.

item.name: Conversations
item.description: One Business–Ambassador conversation per pair. Not campaign-scoped. Open returns 201 or 200. After persist, messages broadcast message.created on private conversation.{id}. Channel auth: POST /api/broadcasting/auth (Sanctum). Local: php artisan reverb:start. Production WebSocket/ALB is pending.

item.name: Deals
item.description: Deal create/list/show, payment evidence, Business confirm/reject, and party cancel while payment_pending (MH-BE-027C). Cancel is terminal. No sealed/completed cancel, refund, or clawback.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Placeholder.

item.name: Commissions
item.description: Business→Ambassador liability and settlement recording (MH-BE-019/020). due → paid → received. No payout.

item.name: Disputes

query.description: Optional. DisputeStatus: submitted | under_review | evidence_requested | decision_pending | resolved | closed

item.description: Dispute foundation (MH-BE-025D). Report Issue, party list/show, Admin investigation. No DealStatus disputed / financial mutation.
